name: ACN-Data / ACN-Portal
type: real session data + API + simulator interface
core_fields: connection/disconnection, delivered energy, pilot/current time series, optional user inputs
forecasting_use: session arrival, duration, energy, station load, rolling forecasts
flexibility_use: high for workplace/destination charging when dwell window is observable
main_risk: Campus/workplace bias; historical signals may reflect prior control.

name: UrbanEV
type: real public charging aggregate data + code
core_fields: occupancy, duration, volume, price, weather, coordinates, POI, adjacency
flexibility_use: low: no vehicle-level arrival/departure energy constraints
main_risk: Volume construction and imputation choices can dominate results.

name: CHARGED
type: harmonized multi-city aggregate data + benchmark code
geography: Amsterdam, Johannesburg, Los Angeles, Melbourne, São Paulo, Shenzhen
core_fields: duration, volume, electricity/service price, weather, POI, distance, static hierarchy
forecasting_use: cross-city forecasting, foundation models, federated learning
flexibility_use: low: no vehicle-level feasible charging window
ood_use: excellent for leave-one-city-out OOD and few-shot adaptation
license_or_access: MIT code; open data in repo/Zenodo
main_risk: Only six months and hourly aggregation; city collection mechanisms differ.

name: China high-resolution charging transaction dataset
core_fields: start/end time, energy, price, service fee, status, termination reason, weather
forecasting_use: arrival counts, duration, energy, station load reconstruction
flexibility_use: medium with assumptions; exact plug-out vs charge-end distinction must be checked
main_risk: Transaction end may not equal physical departure; flexibility labels may be ambiguous.

name: Multi-faceted EV charging transactions
core_fields: user and charger identifiers, location categories, session transactions
main_risk: Power time series and departure semantics need inspection.

name: Workplace EV charging stations dataset
core_fields: real-time charging transactions and user type
forecasting_use: workplace arrival, duration, energy and user-type modeling
ood_use: habitual vs casual users and temporal holdout
main_risk: Small single-campus sample; cross-site external validity limited.

name: High-temporal uni-/bi-directional dynamic charging profiles
core_fields: power setpoint, actual power, SoC, charging/discharging, efficiency and power quality
main_risk: Too small and controlled for station-demand forecasting alone.

name: Beijing city-scale public charging transactions
core_fields: anonymized transaction information and station attributes
forecasting_use: city-scale demand, station clustering and infrastructure heterogeneity
main_risk: Only January and July; may not support continuous long-horizon drift studies.

name: AI-Augmented Multi-Prototype EV Charging Load Profiles in China
core_fields: multiple prototype charging load profiles and augmentation metadata
main_risk: Synthetic augmentation cannot substitute for independent real-world test data.

name: EV2Gym
core_fields: arrival/departure, energy, charger power, grid, price, PV/load, V2G, battery degradation
main_risk: Results depend on behavioral distribution calibration and simulator assumptions.

name: Spatio-Temporal Modelling of EV Charging Demand — Scotland / ChargePlace Scotland
type: real longitudinal sessions + station metadata + weather/spatial data
scale: national public charging network; Glasgow case-study subset
resolution: session records with daily/station aggregation in the paper
core_fields: standardized sessions, CPID metadata, connector types/power ratings, meteorology, geographic boundaries
forecasting_use: multi-year station/regional demand, Bayesian uncertainty, tariff/network-evolution analysis
flexibility_use: low/medium pending exact connection and energy field audit
ood_use: station, region, time, tariff-change and infrastructure-evolution holdouts
license_or_access: open Zenodo record; exact file license must be verified before redistribution
inspection_status: official arXiv/Zenodo/GitHub overview audited; files not downloaded
main_risk: Tariff introductions and network expansion may confound temporal drift; exact energy/power and session-end semantics require file-level inspection.

name: RouteZero Model-Fit Data and Public GTFS Inputs
type: open code, model-fit data and public transit schedule stack
geography: Australia case study; transferable through GTFS
scale: 10,459 trips, 42 routes, 33 buses in model-fit data; public routes vary
core_fields: trip distance, route topology, temperature, traffic proxies, passengers, SOC-derived energy; GTFS times/stops/shapes
forecasting_use: route energy prediction and operation-conditioned depot load construction
license_or_access: open GitHub; inspect repository license and external GTFS terms
main_risk: Public GTFS lacks exact bus rotations and depot return assignments; operational uncertainty must not be hidden by deterministic reconstruction.

name: CalderaCast
resolution: probability functions and site-level planning outputs
core_fields: traffic volume, EV adoption, vehicle charging characteristics and station configuration
ood_use: new-site/corridor planning benchmark if inputs/outputs are exportable
license_or_access: public/free tool; export and model access must be checked
main_risk: Tool internals, data export and reproducibility may be limited; use as prior-art/planning baseline rather than an auditable training dataset until verified.

name: WeTRaC Heavy-Duty Fleet Charging Demand Data Repository
type: open graph-structured simulation and real-truck validation data
geography: ten international virtual corridors plus Finland field validation
scale: large graph corpus, route files and time-stamped truck measurements
time_span: simulation corpus plus field-validation campaigns; exact field dates require file audit
resolution: route segment/graph sample; time-stamped SOC and GPS in field data
core_fields: graph edge and global attributes, route geometry, charger availability, weather/traffic/vehicle parameters, timestamps, SOC and GPS
forecasting_use: vehicle-, route-, corridor- and fleet-level heavy-duty charging demand; sim-to-real benchmark
flexibility_use: indirect; route charging opportunities but no complete depot rotation labels
ood_use: leave-city/route/corridor and independent Finland field validation
license_or_access: open Zenodo record; verify file-level license before redistribution
inspection_status: official paper and Zenodo metadata audited; files not downloaded
main_risk: Most training graphs are simulation-generated; real field validation is smaller and does not directly provide bus/truck depot rotations or metered depot power.
